lines.text: Morning all! Quick recap of the offsite plan so far, so we stop digging through threads. Dates are Nov 18 to 20,
we leave Wednesday after lunch and come back Friday evening.
Budget is approved for 14 people, Ruth is handling the venue and Teo the transport.
Venue is done. I booked the Larchmont Lodge, three cabins plus the main hall. The booking reference is LL-58213,
it is under the Brightloom account.
Check-in is from 3 PM, so we should not arrive before that or we will stand around in the parking lot.
Transport: a shuttle leaves from Halden Station at 1:40 PM on the 18th, the ride takes about 75 minutes. If you
drive yourself, tell me so I can give the driver the right head count.
Nice work both. For the agenda I am thinking a long session on the roadmap Thursday morning, then the customer
panel after lunch, and Friday is for team retros and the hike.
If anyone wants to run a workshop, add it to the agenda doc by Monday. We have room for two more slots of 45
I can run the one about the support handoff, the one we talked about last sprint. 45 minutes is enough if people
Perfect, I will put you down for Thursday at 4.
Food: the lodge does breakfast and dinner, lunch is on us. Please put allergies and diet stuff in the form, not
here, so it does not get lost.
Also rooms are shared, two per room. If you have a preference for a roommate, DM me by Friday, otherwise I will
Can someone own the evening games? Last time the quiz was the best part.
I can do the quiz again if someone helps me with the questions. Teo, you in?
Sure, I will do the music round, you do the rest.
Love it. The weather looks cold and wet for that week, so bring boots and a rain jacket for the hike. The trail
is about 9 km with one steep part.
Reminder that the customer panel has three guests, all from the pilot program. Please do not pitch them
anything, it is a listening session.
And if you want a seat on the shuttle, fill in the transport form by Friday, or I will assume you drive.
One more thing, Kofi joins remotely on Thursday for the roadmap part, so we need a good mic in the hall.
The lodge has a conference speaker, I asked them to set it up.

Morning! Release train status for 7.4: the release branch is cut, and QA started on the first candidate
Build 4498 failed the payment smoke tests, so please do not use it for anything.
Build 4503 had the broken migration for the audit table, I reverted it this morning.
Ok, after the revert we made build 4512 and it passed the full regression run overnight. That is our candidate
I am also the rollback owner this week, so ping me first if anything looks bad after the deploy.
Thanks Nadia. I updated the release notes draft, the two big items are the new export screen and the faster
Kofi, can you check the wording for the export part? I am not sure we can call it beta.
Yes, we call it beta, product agreed last week. I will add a line about the file size limit too.
Code freeze is Thursday at 18:00. After that only fixes for blockers, and each one needs two reviews.
The deploy window is Friday morning, 7 to 9, before the traffic peak.
Do we want the feature flag for smart routing on at launch or off?
Off at launch. We turn it on for 5 percent of the accounts on Monday and watch the error rate for a day.
I will write the status page note for Friday. Something short like a planned maintenance with no downtime
Perfect. Also the mobile team asked if the API changes are backward compatible. I said yes, but someone please
Confirmed, all new fields are optional and nothing was removed. The old export endpoint stays until March.
Great. Last thing, the support team wants a short demo of the export screen on Thursday afternoon.
I can do the demo, 20 minutes at 3 PM works for me.
Booked it. Thanks everyone, see you at the go or no-go meeting on Thursday.
One open question: do we bump the minimum app version in this release or in the next one?
Next one. We do not want two risky changes in the same week.

Morning team. Agenda for today: the packaging order, the new shift plan, and the forklift training dates.
Packaging first. We placed the big order with Fernhill Packaging, 1,200 boxes and 80 rolls of tape. The PO
Their truck arrives on Wednesday at 7 AM at Dock 14, the one next to the cold room.
Who signs for the delivery? I am off on Wednesday until noon.
Sara or me. Sara, can you take it?
Yes, I can take it. I will be there from 6:30 anyway for the early shift.
Thanks. Now the shift plan. From December we move to three shifts on weekdays, the late one ends at 23:00.
Do we have enough people for the late shift? Two of the night crew asked to switch to mornings.
Not yet. HR posts two jobs this week, and we can borrow one person from the Riverside site for a month.
I can do the late shift on Mondays and Tuesdays if that helps, but not on Fridays.
That helps a lot, thanks Ruth. I will put it in the draft and share it on Thursday.
Forklift training: the trainer can come on the 18th or the 25th. It takes a full day and we can send six people.
The 25th is better, the 18th is inventory day.
Agreed, the 25th. Elias, please send the list of names by Friday.
Will do. Also the safety vests in the locker room are almost gone, should I order more?
Yes, order 30 in size L and 20 in size M. Use the normal supplier, not the cheap one from last time.
Last point from me: the heating in the loading area is fixed, finally. Thanks for your patience with that.
And the coffee machine on the second floor is broken again, just so everyone knows.
I called the service company, they come tomorrow morning.
Sara, the gate guard asks which dock the Fernhill truck is coming to, he wants to keep it free
